correctness.rationale: Use actual Holliday P1–P5 as written. P3 and P4 give f_x(y)=f_x(x∧y) and isotonicity. P1/P2 force f_1=id and f_0 constant d. P5 becomes f_x(f_t(z))<=f_t(z) for every t<=x, reducing on N5 to self-absorption for rows a,b,c, f_x(d)<=d, and f_c(f_a(z))<=f_a(z). Exhaustive actual order-table reconstruction yielded 5,250 row-reduced candidates, tested all five axioms for each, and obtained 276, with exact d counts (16,18,26,36,180). Independently checked antitone ν(1)=0, induced rows ν(x)∨(x∧y) give 96 distinct operations, and the all-pairs modus-ponens test gives 59. The finite universe is completely enumerated, not sampled. Trivial automorphism follows unique distinguished element b and fixed 0<a<c<1.
residual_risks: Finite diagnostics are supporting and do not substitute for infinite/general argument.
